infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CircleBites uses the camera to capture food photos and short food videos for posts.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: CircleBites uses the microphone to record sound with food videos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CircleBites uses your photo library so you can add food photos and videos to posts.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CircleBites uses your location to show nearby restaurants and dishes.
